summary: Schedule repeated Node.js timer callbacks using a Timeout handle and Node timer-phase semantics.

target.notes: Preserve repeated scheduling, cancellation, Timeout identity, callback receiver, and event-loop liveness.

semantics.delay: default 1 ms; numeric delay <1, NaN, or >2147483647 becomes 1; non-integer delays are truncated for scheduling
semantics.arguments: extra arguments are passed on every invocation
semantics.callback_this: ordinary function receives the Timeout handle as this
semantics.overlap: callbacks execute serially on the JS event loop; no concurrent callback overlap
semantics.overflow_warning: out-of-range delays may emit Node TimeoutOverflowWarning under the selected host profile

caveats: Do not model an interval as a concurrent .NET periodic callback that can overlap JavaScript execution.
Elapsed wall-clock time does not guarantee exact callback count.
Preserve host-visible warning behavior when compatibility requires Node TimeoutOverflowWarning.
